bundle: CanDoItAll Runtime, Tools, and Process Drivers
title: Plugins, FileTools, and host integrations

tasks.title: Inject Docker host execution dependencies
tasks.description: Remove direct LocalWorkspaceProcessHost construction. Consume B01 process host, resolver, environment policy, workspace scope, registry, and receipt primitives.

tasks.title: Separate Docker executable and daemon capability
tasks.description: Probe executable, context/config, daemon/socket/remote endpoint, authorization, and recipe-specific capability without passing arbitrary Docker environment; project the typed result through the asynchronous runtime executor catalog and execution gate.

tasks.title: Harden Docker environment and paths
tasks.description: Use OS/tool-specific environment names with host case semantics; validate Docker config/root paths and scheme-specific local/remote endpoints through Core C4 contracts; reject endpoint credentials and redact normalized protected values.

tasks.title: Produce FileTools compatibility report
tasks.description: Test the exact direct-source FileTools development identity on Windows and Ubuntu headless for open, reveal, preferred application, cancellation, unsupported state, and path safety; keep actual macOS deferred and keep unvalidated package-mode desktop launching fail-closed until publication proof exists.

tasks.title: Quarantine or upgrade unsupported FileTools behavior
tasks.description: Compile FileTools desktop launching as unavailable outside the validated direct-source mode until the package is published and separately proven; do not reimplement its internals opportunistically in this bundle.

tasks.title: Make desktop actions host-bound and optional
tasks.description: Use Core host-bound application preferences, desktop-session capability, and explicit enablement. Service/headless profiles must not attempt GUI launch.

tasks.title: Create external dependency ledger/probes
tasks.description: For every plugin/native dependency record version, source, supported OS/profile, probe, permissions, failure mode, remediation, and test evidence.

tasks.title: Run plugin/desktop failure matrix
tasks.description: Cover missing Docker, denied/socket/link endpoint, remote host, indeterminate Docker inventory, missing desktop session, foreign executable preference, unvalidated package mode, timeout, cancellation immediately before delegation, and link-safe path open.

tasks.title: Issue integration gate R3b
tasks.description: Proceed to Processes only after optional integrations degrade independently and no duplicate process/path/secret stack remains.
